limitations: Research only: NOT point-in-time universe; survivor/lookahead selection bias possible.
Signal-level columns must have been computed only from data available at T-1; not independently verified.
2025 is a later-period check, not an untouched statistically independent out-of-sample test.
Periods share the same full OHLCV date index; returns and MDD are comparable within periods but may reflect cross-period holdings.
Multiple filter comparisons can overfit; no single winning filter is approved for live trading.
Capital scenarios are sensitivity checks, not fixed account allocation.
No intraday sequence, limit order queue, liquidity, tax, or market impact simulation.
